subject: LuminaHealth: Dedicated GPU pool onboarding & kickoff planning
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: LuminaHealth Dedicated GPU pool onboarding & kickoff planning

Hi Elena —

Great to get LuminaHealth across the line. As discussed on the call, we want to lock in an onboarding plan for your dedicated capacity (GPU pool) so we can meet the ramp dates you shared. High level asks from us today:

- Confirm target region (we recommended us-west-2 for lowest latency to your West Coast infra).
- Target steady-state qps / concurrent requests and peak multiplier for burst planning.
- Any compliance or audit items (SOC2 scope, data residency) that affect private deployment.

I've sketched a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that splits ownership between your team, Redwood CS, and Redwood Ops (attached as lumina_onboard_mpa.xlsx). Key milestones: contract sign, SOW finalization, provisioning window, internal netops whitelisting, and live traffic cutover.

Next steps: can we do a technical kickoff with Lumina infra + procurement this week? I propose Thursday 12/11 10:00am PT. If that works, I'll have Monica and Priyom join to start sizing and autoscale/burst policy decisions.

Best,
Rishi
Head of Sales — Dedicated
Redwood Inference

[attachment: lumina_onboard_mpa.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@luminahealth.com>

Subject: Re: LuminaHealth Dedicated GPU pool onboarding & kickoff planning

Thanks Rishi —

Thursday 12/11 10:00am PT works for us. Region confirmed: us-west-2.

Some additional context for the kickoff:
- Our projected steady-state is ~60 concurrent inference sessions. Peak jobs during mornings could be ~4x for short windows (batching window allowed).
- Compliance: SOC2 in-scope, but we need to keep logs for 365 days and provide audit access. No additional data residency constraints beyond the US.
- Procurement wants the SOW redline before final signatures — I'll route your draft to procurement today.

I'll include our infra lead (cc'd) in the kickoff invite once we finalize time.

Cheers,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Platform Engineering
LuminaHealth

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@luminahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 08:50:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: LuminaHealth kickoff prep — sizing & autoscale proposal

Team —

Elena confirmed Thursday 12/11 10:00am PT and region us-west-2. Quick alignment notes so we go in prepared:

1) Pool sizing recommendation
- Steady-state target: 60 concurrent sessions -> equivalent to ~18 A100 80GB v2 slots if we assume average model (approx 3 sessions per GPU under target latency).
- Peak multiplier: 4x for short morning spikes; propose burst capacity of +8 GPUs reserved as burst for 15-30 minute windows.

2) Autoscale & burst policy proposal (to present)
- Baseline autoscale: target CPU/GPU utilization 60-70% threshold for scale-out.
- Burst policy: allow preemptible spot-equivalent capacity up to 30% of pool but with automatic fallback to a smaller quantized model if spot is unavailable.
- Warm-standby KV cache priming: preload most common prefixes during scheduled overnight warmup to reduce cold-start token cost.

3) Compliance ops
- Monica: we'll need the 365-day audit log retention. Can we confirm log export schedule and retention SLA?

4) SOW redlines
- Priyom, Ben: Elena said procurement wants redlines. I've attached the draft SOW (lumina_sow_draft.pdf). Please flag any ops- or security-related exceptions quickly so legal can update before the call.

I'll run the MAP briefly at the top of the call, then hand to Monica/Ben for technical kickoff.

Thanks —
Rishi

[attachment: lumina_sow_draft.pdf (pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@luminahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Dec 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: LuminaHealth kickoff prep — sizing & autoscale proposal

Quick replies / notes before kickoff:

- Log retention: we can provide 365-day audit logs via our logging pipeline; I will confirm retention export cadence and sample CSV export during the call.

- Autoscale: agree with the 60-70% utilization threshold. For burst: propose a two-tier burst approach:
  * Tier A (warm reserve): +6 GPUs hot-warmed for <30min bursts (billed at reserved rate).
  * Tier B (spotish): +12 transient instances used for extended peaks; add model-quantization fallback policy in case Tier B capacity gaps occur.

- Networking: Elena, we will need the IP blocks for your NAT gateways for whitelisting. Priyom, please prepare firewall chart and expected ports (gRPC + console access restrictions).

- Cutover timeline: propose 3-week rollout from sign (week 1: provisioning & netops; week 2: integration testing + priming KV cache; week 3: canary traffic -> full cutover). We can compress if procurement wants an earlier go-live.

See you on the call.

—Monica
Senior Customer Success Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@luminahealth.com>

Attached are the SOW comments from procurement — redlines are inline on the PDF. Procurement specifically asked for clarification on SLA credits for burst-induced failures and a clause around fallback to quantized models. They also asked for an explicit list of audit artifacts we will receive (log extract schema).

Procurement will review a revised SOW and expects final sign by end of next week if we can incorporate these items quickly.

Thanks for turning this around.

Elena

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@luminahealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Dec 2025 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: LuminaHealth — Scheduling provisioning window & next actions

Hi all —

Following the call and procurement redlines, ops is ready to schedule the provisioning window. Proposed timeslot: Friday 12/19 02:00am-06:00am PT (low traffic window for Lumina). Planned actions during the window:

- Reserve baseline pool: 18 A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west-2.
- Deploy Tier A warm reserve (+6 GPUs) and configure autoscale thresholds (60% scale-out, 40% scale-in).
- Configure Tier B transient capacity policy and fallback quantized-model route.
- Enable 365-day audit logging and verify log export to Lumina's designated S3 (we will test with a 24-hour export sample).

Action items to close before provisioning:
- Elena: provide NAT IP blocks and S3 bucket IAM role for log export.
- Procurement: sign SOW with the updated SLA credit language and quantized-fallback clause.
- Priyom: share firewall/port diagram and the runbook for the provisioning window (I will attach after you send it).

If procurement needs more time for signature we can shift window to the following week; otherwise I'll send a calendar invite for 12/19 and the internal runbook later today.

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Operations Manager — Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference
